title: chore(news): rename the news scripts and remove leftovers
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Renamed the news pipeline scripts and README-sync workflow, and folded model announcement and API-change handling into gist.py. Moved the per-PR Discord prompt to prompts/posts/discord-pr.md, removed the unused format prompt, six uncalled common.py functions, an unused per-PR crosspost, and the outdated social README; rewrote PIPELINE.md. CI now runs news tests when social prompts change. Checks against existing news data found identical per-PR Discord requests for 15 gists, identical index and README output, and an identical 221-model catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and tidies labeled news-script folders beside a lime green (#ecf874) glowing terminal and potted code-plants; Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small within the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic, against a soft pastel gradient with warm lighting: cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
